name: Sesame Tuna Rice Bowl with Lettuce, Cucumber, Radish & Avocado
ingredients: 4 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water
instructions: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place half in a medium bowl. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
Drain tuna, add to the bowl with the green onion, and flake with a fork. Add mayo, oil, vinegar, soy sauce, and chili-garlic sauce; stir to combine and set aside.
Place additional mayo, vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, and garlic powder in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Place on a large plate.
Trim and slice radishes crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the plate with the cucumber.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the plate.
Halve lettuce lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips.
Divide rice, tuna, and veggies between bowls; top with reserved green onions and sesame seeds. Serve with dressing on the side and enjoy!
author: Mealime
